name: Campaign Finance - Report Detail
description: This dataset contains data about the Campaign Finance Report received by a filer. The Reports table contains information about the type of report filed, the due date, original filing date, and transaction totals. To access the Transactions table, where individual transactions are listed, please go to: Campaign Finance - Transaction Detail A data dictionary for this dataset is available at Campaign Finance Data - Data Dictionary * This dataset may not receive new data daily. "Data Last Updated" reflects the date of when new data was published.
